Upstream: https://github.com/kode54/SSEQPlayer
Commit: 77222d3657adff358fb4e610d3e56bb7ada8ec24

Local changes: replace negative constant left shift with multiplication in consts.h.
Build renames Player/Track/Channel to avoid game symbol collisions.
Local changes: use standard <codecvt>, avoiding legacy std type redefinitions with GCC16.
Local changes: remove legacy codecvt facet ID definitions from Player.cpp.
Local changes: SSAR.h/.cpp are native-port additions for bounded archive/entry parsing.
SDAT supports SSAR entry offsets and an explicit bank override for scene sounds.
Missing banks/wave bindings now fail explicitly instead of dereferencing null.
Player channel allocation no longer forms channels[-1] before selecting its first candidate.
Track rendering throws on >65536 commands without yielding; this is a diagnostic
bound, not an implementation of Nitro zero-duration-note/loop scheduling.
Local changes: zero-duration notes with note-wait enabled now suspend the track
until its active channel list empties, matching ROM ARM7 02384c98/02384e3c.
Local changes: SDATBankState retains wave bindings across aliases of the same
SBNK file; explicit metadata bindings replace slots, FFFF preserves prior slots.
Different file IDs reset inherited slots. Bank/wave ownership starts before Read
so exceptions release partially parsed resources.
Local changes: PseudoFile accepts a non-owning external byte view as well as its
legacy vector input. The C boundary uses it for a temporary malloc-owned archive
copy, avoiding fragmentation of the game's root heap; parsed data owns its copies.
Local changes: END releases the track's active notes, matching the ARM7
completion aggregator (02384c1c -> 02385968 -> 02385ab0).
Local changes: Setup consumes the initial track-allocation mask at the selected
entry offset. Track IDs map sixteen logical slots; OPEN_TRACK restarts only an
existing non-self slot without resetting parameters. END frees its slot, and
release tails detach from track ownership before reuse. Hard stop kills orphan tails.
Local changes: PseudoFile validates scalar and byte-span reads against its buffer
length. Setup rejects an allocation-mask-only event region without any command.

Local shared-pool adaptation: optional global32-track/16-channel storage, single
sample/clock scheduler, owner-aware stop/destruction/channel stealing, and
release-stop detachment before track reuse. Standalone rendering preserved.

Local pause adaptation: preserve sequencer position/wait/tempo and active mask,
release attached notes with override127, and keep the shared hardware clock and
other players running. Verified against ARM7 command02386204/scheduler023863f0.

Local volume correction: initialize sequence attenuation from metadata, preserve
explicit INFO zero volume, and propagate live external attenuation to attached
tracks. Synthetic metadata defaults to127; runtime command0 starts at127.

Local priority correction: independent player/track bytes default64; allocation
compares their integer sum, stores the low byte, and tied notes retain their
existing channel priority. Verified against ROM allocation and tie paths.

Local external track controls: separate signed attenuation/pan/tune contributions
and live modulation speed/depth updates for the original command4 field mapping.

Local command5 adaptation: selected-track mute/release-only semantics, continuing
event timing and portamento updates while suppressed, and native key clamping.

Local command6 adaptation: per-track 16-bit channel allocation masks, default
ffff and explicit-mask state; instrument-compatible future allocations respect
the mask while existing/tied notes retain their channels. Global locks pending.

Local sequence-variable correction: sixteen player-local variables and sixteen
SoundPool globals shared by FROMVAR, arithmetic and comparison events. Setup
resets locals only; stop preserves parameters/variables. Invalid indices reject
rather than accessing outside native arrays. ROM resolver02384bd8 reference.

Local lifetime adaptation: optional externally backed sixteen local variables
let mixer slot status outlive sequence resource owners; standalone players keep
internal storage. Stop/destruction do not reset the external status.

Local tick accounting: count all scheduled ticks before event execution, retain
per-slot counters across resource collection, reset on Setup, skip paused/inactive
players, free unused reserved tracks at completion. ROM023859f8 reference.

Local DS-fidelity corrections (2026-10-08, compared against melonDS register,
per-channel and mixer taps; build3ds/validation/sound-fidelity-v1):
- DS-native cadence: rate 32728 selects one output sample per 1024 ARM7
  cycles (32728.498 Hz = 3DS NDSP_SAMPLE_RATE); sequencer clock in cycles.
- Channel stepping uses the hardware timer model (16-bit counter, reload on
  overflow, integer source position) instead of double increments; output
  after the timer advance; ADPCM start delay includes the 8-nibble header.
- Mixing uses the DS arithmetic: volume shift {4,3,2,0}, volume/pan/master
  127 counted as 128, pan 128-p/p, 2^-10 accumulation, >>8 capture/speaker.
- Portamento/sweep follow ARM7 02385720/02383d9c: sweep length from the note
  length converted to hardware ticks (also for tied notes; FSS used -1 and the
  pitch dived to timer saturation), counter per hardware tick, track sweep
  pitch applied without portamento; tied notes take track ADSR overrides.
- Note lengths count down in hardware ticks after each channel update
  (ARM7 023848dc), converted from sequencer ticks at the current tempo.
- Interpolation history is only maintained for interpolating hosts.
- SWAR parses waves in place (no copy of the archive); SWAV::Prepare (game
  thread, before the locked start) allocates the decoded buffer only for the
  waves of the programs the starting sequence can reach (static scan of the
  events from the entry, whole bank when unbounded; audio/sseq_decoder.cpp
  sequence_programs) and parks the ADPCM/PCM8 bytes at its tail; the first
  Samples() call (realtime renderer) decodes in place without allocating.
  Track::NoteOn skips an unprepared wave (sm64ds_sseq_unprepared_notes, 0 on
  every validated route). Previously every first-use archive was fully
  decoded on the game thread (~140 ms stalls per new sound in mini-games).
  Sinc tables built on first sinc interpolation only (~110 ms at pool
  creation). Output unchanged.
